purpose: Teach: に当たって/満たし/満たさ/遂げ/併せ/略し/測っ/揃える

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 捜査に当たって、警察は慎重です
lines.en: In conducting the investigation, we proceed with caution.
lines.style: Professional, measured tone. Even pacing. The opening carries quiet authority without harshness. Slight pause before 'caution' — allowing the weight of procedure to settle.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察は条件を満たしておりありがたいです
lines.en: Yes. We appreciate how thoroughly the police are meeting our requirements.
lines.style: Respectful, formal register. Deliberate pacing — each phrase landing with care. Genuine gratitude underneath the politeness, not performative. Slight forward lean in the voice.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 証拠を満たさない事件は警察も慎重です
lines.en: When evidence is incomplete, we have to be even more thorough.
lines.style: Calm, explanatory. The speaker is educating, not lecturing. Warm underneath the procedural language. Steady breath — this is familiar ground for him.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察は目的を遂げております
lines.en: Yes. The police have been achieving our shared objectives.
lines.style: Formal affirmation. Measured pace. Slight emphasis on 'shared' — acknowledging partnership. Respectful but not deferential. The tone of someone confirming alignment.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察と地域、併せて防犯を進めます
lines.en: Together, the police and community will advance crime prevention efforts.
lines.style: Formal statement of purpose. Steady, authoritative but not cold. Slight emphasis on 'together' — stressing collaboration over hierarchy. Even tempo throughout.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察名簿を略して掲示しました
lines.en: Yes. We've posted an abbreviated roster of the officers involved, as requested.
lines.style: Respectful confirmation. Clear, steady pacing. The tone of someone checking boxes on a shared list. Professional warmth — this is coordination, not burden.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 現場を測って警察は記録しております
lines.en: We've measured and documented the scene thoroughly.
lines.style: Factual, reassuring. Steady pace with slight emphasis on 'documented' — conveying completeness without boasting. Professional certainty. The tone of someone who has done this work before.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。証拠を揃えるよう警察もご対応ありがたいです
lines.en: Yes. We're grateful for your diligence in gathering all available evidence.
lines.style: Warm gratitude over formal frame. Slightly slower pace — the sincerity pulls the pacing down. Soft on the final phrase. The voice of someone who recognizes partnership and thoroughness.
